findings.message: The raw data block at 0x64 holds an ics_reserved_bit of 1, where the specification requires 0.
The raw data block at 0x130 holds 0 single channel elements, 1 channel pair element and 0 LFE elements, other than channel configuration 1 defines.
The raw data block at 0x139 holds ms_mask_present 3, which the specification reserves.
The raw data block at 0x223 holds pulse data in eight short windows, which the specification allows only in long ones.
The raw data block at 0x30B holds a scalefactor outside 0 to 255, for which ffmpeg's decoder rejects the access unit.
The raw data block at 0x3E2 holds a TNS filter of a higher order than the 12 its window allows.
The raw data block at 0x4CC holds fill data other than the fill nibble 0000 and fill bytes 10100101 the specification requires.
